title: Plants vs. Zombies: Hybrid Edition (植物大战僵尸杂交版)
notes:
Fan-made mod of the original single-threaded PopCap engine (GDI/DDraw renderer), so GPU upgrades do not help. **Launch: start the game from `pvzHE-Launcher.exe` and wait 30–40 s** — the launcher re-extracts game files and loads resources on every start. If the window shows only a title bar or a blank body, drag or resize the window once to force a redraw. **Do not click rapidly**: input bursts can hang the game. If the screen freezes white, the legacy Microsoft Pinyin IME is the usual culprit — switch to an English input source (the same freeze family exists on real Windows).

民间魔改作品,基于原版 PopCap 单线程引擎(GDI/DDraw 渲染),显卡再好也没有帮助。**启动:从 `pvzHE-Launcher.exe` 进入后等待 30–40 秒** —— 启动器每次都会重新释放游戏文件并加载资源。若窗口只有标题栏或一片空白,拖动或缩放一次窗口即可强制重绘。**不要快速连点**:输入风暴会把游戏卡死。白屏卡死多半是旧版微软拼音输入法钩子所致,切换到英文输入法即可(真 Windows 上也有同样的毛病)。
